routine: 복습 3분(영어 가리고 먼저 쓰기) → 가리고 써 보기 2분(빈칸 먼저, 맨 끝 정답 확인) → 새 내용 5분(노트에 옮길 때 짝 표현째로) → 소리 내어 3번 읽기 3분 → 오늘 쓸 표현 1개 골라 실제 메일에 쓰기

review.title: 복습 (10/29·10/27·10/22 표현 + 오답, 영어로 먼저 써 보기)

items.prompt: (계속) 지켜보다, 점검하다 — check again every month 대신
우선 처리하다, 먼저 하다 — do first 대신

items.answer: Please keep me posted on ~ until ~.
When will you be able to ~?
If ~ is not ~ by ~, we will have to ~.

items.prompt: 예상되는 — the date you will finish 대신

items.answer: Please update us as soon as ~.
Just a reminder that ~ is due ~.

items.prompt: 실행 가능한 — possible to do 대신
(가격·조건을) 협상하다 — ask for a lower price 대신
아직 처리·제출되지 않은 — not yet received 대신

cover_practice.prompt: 진행하다: Please p______ with the PR once the GM approves it.
초과하다: No worker should e_____ 40 hours of overtime in a month.
일정을 다시 잡다: The fire drill was r__________ to next Tuesday.
정확한: Please make sure the headcount data is a_______.
허용량: What is the baggage a________ for this ticket?

words.example: Please proceed with the Malaysia Airlines option on 10 Nov.

words.meaning: (한도를) 넘다, 초과하다 — over the limit 대신
words.example: If any overtime exceeds the legal limit, please write the reason.
words.collocations: exceed the limit / exceed the budget

words.meaning: 일정을 다시 잡다 — change the date 대신
words.example: If the roof repair is rescheduled, please tell me the new date.
words.collocations: be rescheduled to [날짜] / reschedule the meeting

words.example: Please check that the Vietnamese text in the letter is accurate.
words.collocations: accurate data / make sure ~ is accurate

words.meaning: 허용량, 한도 — how many kg 대신
words.example: The ticket has a baggage allowance of 7kg carry-on and 25kg checked.

patterns.meaning: ~할 경우에는 ~해 주세요 (If 대신, 미리 대비시킬 때)
patterns.email: In case the power goes out, please start the generator and call Mr [이름].
patterns.spoken: Just in case, keep the sandbags ready.

patterns.meaning: ~라는 점 참고해 주세요 (FYI, 주의할 점 알릴 때)
patterns.email: Please note that the ticket includes only 25kg of checked baggage.
patterns.spoken: Just so you know, it's only 25 kilos.

patterns.pattern: We have decided to ~ instead of ~.
patterns.meaning: ~ 대신 ~하기로 했습니다 (let's change the plan 대신, 결정 알릴 때)
patterns.skeleton: We have decided to + [동사원형] + instead of + [동사ing/명사]
patterns.email: We have decided to replace only 4 SSDs now instead of all 13.
patterns.spoken: We'll do four now, not thirteen.

rewrite.original: If the work is delayed by rain, please let me know the new date right away.
rewrite.improved: If the work has to be rescheduled due to rain, please let me know the new date right away.
rewrite.note: is delayed(늦어지다) → has to be rescheduled(날짜를 다시 잡아야 하다): 뒤에 'new date'가 나오므로 '일정 재조정'이라고 쓰면 앞뒤가 맞는다. delayed는 얼마나 늦는지 모호하다. by rain보다 due to rain이 '원인'을 더 분명히 보여 주는 업무 표현이다.

source: 10/29 보낸 메일(태풍 대비·Foodinco 지붕 수리·Trinh·An·Mài, SSD 교체 계획 변경·Quan, Asanka 항공권·수하물·Mai, 10월 근무시간·Ly), 받은 메일(Ponci 'Please include it with the shipping documents', Chamin 'please note that ~', Vanie 'what percentage of the total ~')
